snippet.title: Wario’s Conquest + SML2 Reclaimed - F3 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Join our discord server for regular updates on the game's development!
https://discord.gg/fM6d5NhxF8

Two games in one!

SML2 Reclaimed:
Return to Mario Land in this remake of the Game Boy classic! After his latest adventure in Sarasaland, Mario comes home to find his island in chaos-his old childhood rival Wario has cast a mysterious spell over the land and the 6 Golden Coins have been scattered far and wide!
The game includes enhanced visuals, new music, a mission mode, hidden Silver Coins, local multiplayer and a trove of unlockables!

Wario's Conquest - Beyond Golden Coins:
Meanwhile Wario’s Conquest is a full-fledged alternate campaign and the main focus of this fangame!
Step into the boots of Wario, a ruthless conqueror with a get-rich scheme and something to prove. Backed by the enigmatic Tatanga and an army of oddball misfits, Wario sets sail for Mario Land, ready to claim the throne- but things don’t go as planned...

Designed to be a mix between Wario Land 3 and Wario Land 4, you will explore a metroidvania world where you'll find keys to unlock treasure chests and gain new powers.
Scattered across the world are challenge levels that will task you to complete classic Wario Land 4 styled stages.​

The game also has a gamejolt page!
https://gamejolt.com/games/SML2WCremake/895658
